functions.description: Refresh party member panels for selected item
functions.lever: declare data_ov004_021707d8 as an unsized array of its struct and take a Data* local from it after the member-id struct copy (keeps the address in a callee-saved reg across ldm/stm, as the ROM does); then declare `int count; int i;` before `Battle* battle = data->battle` to fix the loop register colouring
functions.notes: Other closes: stat->SetIcon is a real C++ virtual (vtable slot 0xd8) so `this` is moved before the vtable load; members.ids[j] re-read (not a cached local) with func_020dcc98 taking signed char gives the ROM's reload into sl. Same copy+count-loop idiom as matched 0215db14, which used a holder++/(holder-1) pointer trick instead; the array-extern form avoids that trick. A plain `Data* data = &data_ov004_021707d8` gets constant-propagated and loads the address after the stm (21-byte SHAPE). 31 gate runs plus 2 colorsweep runs.
